project.title: South African research farm wastewater metagenome
project.description: Sequencing wastewater from the Agricultural Research Council- Animal Production Institute (ARC-API) will aid in identifying pathogenic species that may be present on the research farms and discovering antibiotic resistance genes that the bacterial community may be using.

samples: environmental sample from a non-urban site
